caption: Here’s why I support striking Section 224 from the NDAA.
audio_track_actual: Direct speech — Rep. Sara Jacobs's remarks at the House Armed Services Committee FY2027 NDAA markup, June 4, 2026. No music.
video_overlay_text_observed: The U.S. absolutely should NOT further integrate our military relationship with Israel.
audio_content_summary: Jacobs speaks in support of the Khanna amendment to strike Section 224 (the U.S.-Israel Defense Technology Cooperation Initiative) from the FY2027 NDAA. Her argument: the U.S. should hold Israel to the same standards as any other country; the Gaza Health Ministry's 70,000+ count has reportedly been accepted by the Israeli military; OCHA counts 1,079 West Bank deaths including 235 children; the security cabinet approved 34 new settlements; Section 224's 'emerging technology' domains include cyber, where Commerce blacklisted NSO Group in 2021 and NSO is now trying to buy into the U.S. market; the Leahy Law and FAA Section 620I already condition assistance and are not being enforced; Quinnipiac found 60% oppose more military aid to Israel. The amendment failed by voice vote with only Jacobs joining Khanna.
implied_frame: A sitting member of Congress arguing her own amendment position on the record — essentially all of it Group A. Verified: the markup vote and outcome (2026-ndaa-224-002), the reported Israeli-military acceptance of the ~70,000 Gaza toll (2026-gaza-toll-001), the OCHA West Bank toll and the 34-settlement approval (2026-west-bank-001), the NSO blacklisting and U.S.-market comeback push (2026-nso-comeback-001), the statutes as described, and the Quinnipiac 60% figure. Group B (her attributed characterizations, not recorded as fact): that Israel 'has been consistently blocking and restricting humanitarian assistance' and that the Leahy/620I laws are 'not being followed or enforced' — both contested; UN agencies and ex-State officials document restrictions while State under two administrations has declined formal findings. No Group C: every checkable number in the speech checked out.
